description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find. The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app. What you'll work on Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain  Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision. Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market. Our humble expectations We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them. You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience. You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it. You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight. You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick. You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June. You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself. You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype. You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets. You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. title: Senior Product Manager
description: <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>At Too Good To Go, we dream of a planet with no food waste.</strong></span></p> <p>Did you know that more than 40% of all food produced gets thrown away? This unnecessary food waste — and the resources needed to produce and transport it — accounts for 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions.</p> <p>Too Good To Go is a certified B Corporation on a mission to end food waste. We connect stores with surplus food to consumers across 20 markets in Europe, North America, and APAC — with over 140 million registered users, more than 200,000 daily active stores, and 600 million meals saved from going to waste.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Why This Role</strong></span></p> <p>Pricing sits at the centre of everything we do. It shapes what partners earn, what consumers pay, and how much surplus food actually gets saved. Today, pricing decisions are made in different places, for different reasons, without a single team owning the strategy end to end.</p> <p>We are changing that. We are building our first dedicated Pricing team — and you will be the founding member.</p> <p>You will start with a concrete, high-value problem: the pricing infrastructure behind our Key Account deals. That's your launchpad — from there, you will have real scope to shape our approach to dynamic pricing, consumer-facing service fees, and pricing strategy across Too Good To Go more broadly. This is a role built for someone who wants to define a domain, not just execute a brief.</p> <p>The goal behind everything we do is twofold: save as much surplus food as possible, and grow the pie between TGTG, our Partners, and our Consumers — never trading one off against the other.</p> <p>There is a further dimension to this. We are expanding beyond food into new non-food, non-perishable categories — and that growth brings pricing complexity and opportunity we have not had to solve before. Getting ahead of that, rather than reacting to it, is part of this role.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Your Mission</strong></span></p> <p>As Senior Product Manager for Pricing, you will build the foundation for how Too Good To Go prices its marketplace — starting with Key Account deals, then extending across the business.</p> <p>In the near term, you will design and ship the infrastructure that lets us set, manage, and evolve pricing for Key Account partnerships with the flexibility our commercial teams need. From there, you will develop a smarter, more dynamic pricing algorithm that responds to supply, demand, and partner economics — replacing static rules with something genuinely intelligent. Alongside this, you will investigate our consumer-facing service fees: how they're structured, how they're perceived, and where there is room to optimise.</p> <p>Underneath all of it are two questions you will own: how do we price in a way that saves as much surplus food as possible, and how do we grow the pie for everyone — Too Good To Go, our Partners, and our Consumers — rather than shifting value from one side to another? Answering both well means understanding marketplace pricing broadly: the best practices and patterns other two- and three-sided marketplaces use, and what applies to ours.</p> <p>Pricing decisions rarely stay inside one product's boundaries, so you will work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing is right everywhere it shows up, not just within your own roadmap. You will become the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting your strategy and results to the Global Management Team.</p> <p>You will also help lay the pricing groundwork for our move into non-food, non-perishable categories — different cost structures, margins, and purchase patterns than the food pricing we know today, and a chance to shape pricing thinking for a new part of the business from the start.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>The Team</strong></span></p> <p>You will be the founding Pricing PM, operating as an individual contributor, with a small dedicated engineering team of around 3-4 developers to start. We will grow the team's scope and headcount as we prove impact, not before. You will report directly to our VP of Product.</p> <p>This is a new team with a clear starting point, not a fixed script. You will know where to begin — Key Account deals — but how the team's remit, roadmap, and impact grow from there is largely yours to shape. If you want a role where everything is already solved and you are just executing, this isn't it. If you want to help define what great pricing looks like across Too Good To Go, it is.</p> <p>The role is suited to someone who does not need daily direction — who can set the agenda within that mandate, manage up effectively, and make strong pricing calls with incomplete information.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Build the pricing infrastructure for Key Account deals, giving commercial teams the tools and flexibility to structure partnerships well while keeping pricing logic sound and scalable.</li> <li>Design and develop a smart pricing algorithm — moving from static, rules-based pricing toward a dynamic model informed by supply, demand, and partner-specific economics.</li> <li>Investigate consumer-facing service fees: how they're set, how they perform, and how they should evolve to balance consumer value with business sustainability.</li> <li>Take a holistic view of pricing across TGTG, Partners, and Consumers — optimising for meals saved and for growing the pie for all three, rather than trading one off against another.</li> <li>Research and apply best practices and patterns from marketplace pricing more broadly, adapting proven approaches to our specific dynamics rather than reinventing from scratch.</li> <li>Own the roadmap and OKRs for the Pricing team within its agreed mandate, sequencing the work so that early wins on Key Accounts build toward the algorithm and fee strategy.</li> <li>Work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing decisions are right wherever they show up, not just within your own roadmap.</li> <li>Be the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting strategy, models, and results to the Global Management Team.</li> <li>Anticipate the pricing complexity and opportunity of TGTG's expansion into non-food, non-perishable categories, and start laying the groundwork for pricing them well.</li> <li>Use data rigorously — pricing experiments, elasticity analysis, partner and consumer feedback — to test hypotheses before scaling them.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>Multi-year experience in Product Management with direct, hands-on ownership of pricing.</li> <li>Experience with pricing in a marketplace or platform business is a genuine differentiator. If you've worked on take rates, dynamic pricing, two-sided pricing trade-offs, or fee structures in a marketplace, you will hit the ground running.</li> <li>A track record of building pricing algorithms, models, or infrastructure — not just adjusting numbers in a spreadsheet, but shipping systems that price things well and can evolve over time.</li> <li>Comfort working with quantitative teams (data science, analytics, finance) to translate pricing theory into production systems.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>How you work</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>You are comfortable — and genuinely thrive — working independently, with a high degree of autonomy, especially in the early stages of building a new team.</li> <li>You bring a rigorous, quantitative mind. You reason from first principles about supply, demand, and incentives, and you back your recommendations with data and clear models.</li> <li>You can hold multiple stakeholders' interests in view at once — TGTG's, our Partners', and our Consumers' — and make the case for a solution that works for all three.</li> <li>You build genuine working relationships across product and the wider business, not just within your own team, so that pricing is done right wherever it touches the product.</li> <li>You are an excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to senior and executive audiences — including the Global Management Team — with clarity and confidence.</li> <li>You move fast. You do not wait for perfect information. You are decisive, transparent about your reasoning, and quick to adjust.</li> <li>You have a growth mindset. You are always looking for the next level — in the pricing model, in the strategy, and in yourself.</li> <li>You are genuinely fun to work with. You bring your authentic self, you care about the mission, and you know how to succeed as part of a team.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Our Values</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>We win together: food waste is a big beast to fight. We can do it if we win together as Waste Warriors with no ego. We believe in #oneteam.</li> <li>We raise the bar: we always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers, and elevate one another.</li> <li>We keep it simple: our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.</li> <li>We build a legacy: we are proud of the change we are driving.</li> <li>We care: we always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What We Have to Offer</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li>A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company (and certified B Corporation!) where you get to wake up every day knowing you are achieving positive change.</li> <li>The chance to build something genuinely new — a first-of-its-kind Pricing team, with a clear mandate and real influence over how the business grows.</li> <li>Ownership over decisions that touch every side of our marketplace, from Key Account partnerships to millions of consumers.</li> <li>The experience of being part of an international company with 1,200+ enthusiastic and highly talented teammates across 22 countries — always ready to share knowledge and support.</li> <li>Strong personal and professional development in an intense and high-growth scale-up environment.</li> <li>An open company culture where you have the independence and room to unleash your creativity.</li> <li>A strong team culture where successes are celebrated together.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>How to Apply</strong></span></h1> <p>We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.</p> <p>Submit your CV/Cover Letter in English.</p> <p>Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.</p> <h6>&nbsp;</h6> <h6>Job Ref: #LI-CT1</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em data-stringify-type="italic">A Movement for Everyone</em><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong.</em><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Designer
description: <h3>About Dwelly</h3> <p>Dwelly is building the AI operating system for residential lettings. Its growing network of agencies provides its AI with real-world data, continuous feedback, and control over complete workflows, making exceptional service the standard for landlords and tenants. Today, Dwelly operates more than 15,000 properties and $470 million in GMV, making it one of the UK’s ten largest lettings operators. The company has raised $263 million.<br><br>We’re a fast-growing, product-focused company, backed by top-tier investors and led by a team with deep experience in real estate, technology, and operations.</p> <h3>Position Summary</h3> <p>We are seeking a highly talented and hands-on Product Designer to help shape the experience across the full set of Dwelly products (Tenant Find, Property Management, Payments, CRM) and the internal back-office tools that power them. This role involves deeply understanding our user personas (Tenant, Landlord, Maintenance Contractor, Dwelly Agent) and designing for both the customer-facing portals and the operational tools our agents use every day.</p> <p>Given the early stage of the business, our current products are hyper-functional but quite basic — an "MVP" that prioritises getting the job done across all domains. You'll work closely with product and engineering to take these to the next level: bringing clarity, usability, and craft to data-dense, workflow-heavy internal tools, and building genuinely good experiences for tenants and landlords. You'll also help establish the basic building blocks of design at Dwelly — a shared design system, patterns, and a lightweight design process — from the ground up.</p> <p>Our current development team is a team of 5, a few analysts, and one product designer. You'll join a small, fast-moving product team and have an outsized impact on how the whole product looks, feels, and works.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></h3> <p><strong>1. </strong><strong>User Research &amp; Insights</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with product to understand user pain points across all personas — tenants, landlords, maintenance contractors, and internal agents.</li> <li>Turn qualitative and quantitative insights into design decisions.</li> <li>Act as an advocate for usability and the end user within the company.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. End-to-End Product Design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UIs for both customer-facing products (tenant and landlord portals) and internal back-office tools.</li> <li>Design for data-dense, workflow-heavy operational products where clarity and efficiency matter more than decoration.</li> <li>Own the design process from concept and prototyping through to polished, build-ready specs, and iterate after launch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Design Across the Product Suite</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bring consistency and quality across Tenant Find, Property Management, Payments, and the communications/portal layer.</li> <li>Partner closely with engineers and product managers to translate requirements into shippable design, balancing craft with speed and technical feasibility.</li> </ul> <p><strong>4. Design System &amp; Process Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain a shared design system, component library, and reusable patterns.</li> <li>Introduce lightweight design workflows, documentation, and review/handoff practices suited to an early-stage team.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>&nbsp;Qualifications &amp; Preferred Background:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years in product design, with a strong portfolio spanning both complex/operational tools and consumer-facing products. Comfortable in early-stage, low-structure environments as well as more structured, product-led settings.</li> <li><strong>Skills:</strong> Strong interaction and visual design skills; systems thinking; exceptional attention to detail; able to design for complexity and make it feel simple. Excellent communication and collaboration skills across product and engineering.</li> <li>In step with recent technology advancements: <strong>can prototype and ship designs quickly and independently with the help of AI.</strong></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Background:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing operational, back-office, or B2B tools where efficiency and workflow are central — ideally in tech-enabled or operational businesses.</li> <li>Experience building or contributing to a design system from scratch.</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership, a "get things done" attitude, and excellent attention to detail.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on performance, recognising exceptional contributions to our integration success.</li> </ul> <h3>What is it like being a Dwell-er?</h3> <p>Feel free to check out <a href="https://docsend.com/view/7v8gwrjaky7mn895">Dwelly Core Principles</a>. That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.</p> <p>What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for &gt;30% of households (&gt;5M in the UK, and &gt;100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.</p> <p>This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. We work hard, and we shoot for extremely ambitious results. But we want people to be proud of what they’ve built and be able to look back and say one day “hell yeah, that was me that did it all”.</p> <ul> <li>Customer obsession rather than competitive focus</li> <li>Passion for invention</li> <li>Operational excellence</li> <li>Long-term thinking</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-start="556" data-end="829">By applying for this position, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data for recruitment purposes for up to 365 days, in accordance with our data retention policy and applicable data protection laws.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

You'll be part of a team that is passionate about helping ambitious businesses scale globally. We're collaborative, innovative, and deeply embedded in the UK startup ecosystem. Our team values learning, growth, and making a real impact - both for our customers and for each other. This is a place where you'll be empowered to take ownership, build relationships, and help shape the future of fintech in the UK.

What you'll do

As an Account Executive, Startups, you'll play a pivotal role in making Airwallex the finance stack of choice for the next generation of UK startups. You'll work closely with our VC and Community partnerships team to engage Seed-Series A startups, proactively source and outbound high-potential businesses, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience. You'll educate founders on our full product suite, enabling them to build their billing engine from scratch on the Airwallex platform. You'll also embed Airwallex in the startup community by attending events, hosting roundtables, and building our brand across the ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for early-stage startups, from prospecting and qualification to close and onboarding

  • Work closely with the VC Partnerships team to access and engage the next wave of high-growth startups, mapping out the startup ecosysetem strategically including accelerators, incubators, founder communities, angel investment communities, PortCos of key venture funds

  • Proactively source and outbound to Seed/Series A businesses to supplement top-down partnership efforts, identifying key PortCos from our partner funds that we could work with and support

  • Ensure a seamless, founder-friendly onboarding experience, guiding startups through KYC, product setup, and first transactions

  • Educate customers on the benefits of Airwallex's full product suite, helping them build scalable finance operations from day one. Offer monthly office hours for Airwallex for startup companies to book time in to learn more about the product. Identify where we are winning and areas of development. Be data led by collating feedback on which of our competitors are winning within the startup ecosystem and why

  • Actively embed Airwallex in the UK startup community: attend and speak at events, build relationships with founders and ecosystem partners, as well as contributing to startup content e.g. newsletter new product releases, key Airwallex startup news, VC spotlights

  • Be a visible advocate for Airwallex, sharing insights and success stories to build our brand and credibility in the startup ecosystem

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing and customer success to ensure startups get maximum value from Airwallex

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of sales experience in a B2B SaaS, Fintech or payments environment, in a sales development, account executive or account management role

  • Track record of meeting or exceeding targets

  • Demonstrated ability across the sales cycle - from self-sourced prospecting to close and onboarding

  • Genuine affinity and/or experience in the startup ecosystem. Familiarity with the UK startup landscape - key VCs, accelerators, incubators, investor/angel communities

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills - you're articulate, professional and equally comfortable presenting to a room of founders as you are doing a 1:1 deep dive with a Finance Lead over coffee

  • Capable of leading fast, frictionless deals via credible, strategic, visionary conversations with senior founders

  • Confident working in an event-driven activation model - attending and speaking at various events, conferences, dinners

  • Proficient in CRM and outreach tooling, and structured pipeline management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in fintech, payments, or financial services with an understanding of products such as global accounts, payment acceptance, FX, card issuing, or spend management.

  • Hands-on exposure to AI tools and agentic workflows (e.g. Claude, Cursor, or similar), or a track record of being an early adopter who can make new technology tangible for non-technical audiences.

  • Experience managing a backbook or portfolio of accounts alongside new business responsibilities, with demonstrated ability to retain and grow existing customers.

  • A visible personal presence in the startup community — whether through event attendance, LinkedIn activity, community involvement, or existing relationships with founders and investors.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset — prior founder experience or side-project background is a genuine plus, as it deepens your empathy for the customers we serve.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. Equal opportunity

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Beauty&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin,&nbsp;with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior Assistant Merchandiser at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Reporting into the department Merchandising Manager, you will be instrumental in assisting in the management of intake and the stock profile of your department to support driving KPI's. You will be focused on reacting to trade to drive profit, improving efficiencies and providing reporting and analysis whilst mentoring junior members of the team.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As&nbsp;</span><strong><em><span data-contrast="auto">Senior Assistant Merchandiser</span></em></strong><span data-contrast="auto">, you’ll be responsible for: </span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>WSSI management to include risk mitigation and maximise opportunities.</li> <li>Special project management in conjunction with Merchandising Manager.</li> <li>Recommends re buys as necessary, reviewing under and overstocks with suggested actions to maintain optimum stock health.</li> <li>Analyses best and worst sellers making informed recommendations for action. Ensuring best sellers reach their full potential with consistent availability.</li> <li>Supports the MA in managing the end to end critical path and helping to resolve inbound issues, liaising with suppliers, supply chain and buyers to problem solve</li> <li>Escalate and highlight critical path opportunities or concerns to line manager.</li> <li>Attending brand meetings when required and build strong influential relationships.</li> <li>Building collaborative working relationships with buying, marketing and trading counterparts to ensure department strategy is realised.</li> <li>Supporting the Merchandising Manager and Head of Merchandising with excel reporting and preparation, analysis, and overseeing general housekeeping duties.</li> <li>Managing the progression and development of the Admin Assistant.</li> <li>Proactively analyse sales data and trends to ensure high customer valued products are always available whilst working within target cover levels</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> description: <p>At David Zwirner, we look to be an industry leader in our field, with our artists at the center of what we do. Our global exhibition program expands beyond our locations in New York, London, Los Angeles, Hong Kong, and Paris, representing over seventy artists and estates. Home to innovative, singular, and pioneering exhibitions across a variety of media and genres. Active in both the primary and secondary markets, David Zwirner has helped foster the careers of some of the most influential artists today.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Who will work well with us:</strong></p> <ul> <li>The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate and interested in the arts/larger creative arena or is eager to learn.</li> <li>We welcome all individuals entering the workforce, those moving into a new stage of their career or vocation, making a change, returning to work, and those wanting to learn and grow within the industry, to apply.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>About the Opportunity&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Sales Assistant to Senior Partner</strong></p> <p>David Zwirner seeks a full-time Sales Assistant to work alongside one of the gallery's Senior Partners. The Sales Assistant will fulfill administrative assistant duties as well as liaise with curators, artists, and clients for the Senior Partner.</p> <p>Superior writing skills, the ability to time manage and meet deadlines, and a thorough working knowledge of contemporary art are required. This position will involve significant contact with artists and long time clients and other art industry professionals therefore discretion and poise are essential. This position may be scheduled Mondays - Fridays or Tuesdays - Saturdays depending on gallery needs.</p> <p>Candidates must be diligent, extremely organized, and possess excellent time management and communication skills.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Support Senior Partner with roster of artists:</p> <ul> <li>Assist with general artist management of artists’ studios and estates, with exhibitions, requests, press, image requests, general studio requests, events, appraisals and artist care.</li> <li>Monitor all artists’ solo/group exhibitions, both domestic and international, manage checklists and loans.</li> <li>Support with gallery exhibition planning globally.</li> <li>Liaise with other gallery staff regarding all aspects of inventory &amp; exhibition management: production, shipping, framing, photography, research, etc.</li> <li>Create and manage client lists for exhibition previews/dinners, support Director during openings.</li> </ul> <p>Provide broad sales support to Senior Partner:</p> <ul> <li>Manage Senior Partner's sales, help create sales offers, coordinate and prepare for client viewings and prepare insurance appraisals.</li> <li>Conduct post-sale tasks including preparing invoices and coordinating shipping.</li> <li>Manage the Senior Partner's secondary market consignments, prepare consignment and contract agreements; liaise with clients on cataloging and research materials, and create presentations for client offers and significant works.</li> <li>Work across departments to ensure secondary market artworks have photography, provenance and all other relevant documentation.</li> </ul> <p>Provide all administrative support including:</p> <ul> <li>Daily management of Senior Partner’s calendar, agendas, to-do list and help set daily priorities and goals. Prepare travel arrangements, itineraries, appointments and expenses.</li> <li>Responsible for organising the Senior Partner's inbox, and staying on top of all communication requests.</li> <li>Liaise frequently with multiple departments within the gallery to oversee projects such as exhibition and art fair booth models, gallery exhibition checklists, online viewing rooms, sales previews, and press packets, among others.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we would like you to have:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>2-3 years in an assistant or administrative support role at a gallery.</li> <li>Experience supporting senior leadership with calendar management and travel itinerary.</li> <li>Detail oriented with experience in managing upwards.</li> <li>Strong multi-tasking skills with the ability to prioritize and anticipate needs as well as organisational skills.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work cross-departmentally.</li> <li>Strong interest in sales.</li> <li>Passion for and knowledge of contemporary art.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you will love about David Zwirner:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>David Zwirner has pioneered initiatives dedicated to the gallery’s long-standing commitment to kaleidoscopic storytelling, including: <a href="https://www.davidzwirner.com/viewing-room"><strong>David Zwirner Online</strong></a>, <a href="https://www.davidzwirnerbooks.com/"><strong>David Zwirner Books</strong></a>, <a href="https://www.davidzwirner.com/podcast"><strong>Dialogues</strong></a>, <a href="https://utopia-editions.com/"><strong>Utopia Editions</strong></a>, and <a href="https://www.davidzwirner.com/consignments"><strong>Consignments</strong></a>.</li> <li><strong>Premier Access</strong> - to private on-site and off-site events, such as exhibition previews, book signings, talks, and walkthroughs with gallery artists and estate members, and external curators and scholars.</li> <li><strong>Staff-driven projects</strong> and fundraising initiatives. This includes David Zwirner's commitment to <a href="https://www.galleriescommit.com/">Galleries Commit</a>.</li> <li><strong>Competitive Benefits Package!</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Please submit a resume and cover letter, and be prepared to provide three (3) professional references upon request.</strong></p> <p>David Zwirner is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The Gallery is firmly committed to equal employment opportunities in all facets of its operations. The Gallery makes decisions concerning hiring and terms and conditions of employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p>If you need assistance in applying to a role, you may reach out to ----- No calls or walk-ins will be considered for positions at David Zwirner.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. title: Senior AI Research Scientist (Model-based RL)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About Phaidra</strong></h3> <p>Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.</p> <p>The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.</p> <p>Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:</p> <ul> <li>We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.</li> <li>We focus on&nbsp;industrial&nbsp;applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs —&nbsp;perfect for reinforcement learning.</li> <li>We enable domain experts (our users) to&nbsp;configure&nbsp;the AI control&nbsp;systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.</li> </ul> <p>Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with&nbsp;<a href="https://www.nature.com/articles/nature16961">DeepMind's AlphaGo</a>, to reducing the energy required to cool&nbsp;<a href="https://www.technologyreview.com/2018/08/17/140987/google-just-gave-control-over-data-center-cooling-to-an-ai/">Google's Data Centers</a>&nbsp;by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.</p> <p>Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: <strong>Agency,</strong> <strong>Velocity</strong>, <strong>Craft</strong>, and <strong>Truth</strong>. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture</p> <p>Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner,&nbsp;<a href="https://www.oysterhr.com/">OysterHR</a>. Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.</p></div><h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Who You Are</span></h3> <p>Research Scientists at Phaidra lead our efforts in developing novel algorithmic architecture towards the end goal of bringing intelligent control systems to industrial sector.</p> <p>Having pioneered research in the world's leading academic and industrial labs as PhDs, post-docs or professors, Research Scientists join Phaidra to work collaboratively within and across research fields.</p> <p>Drawing on expertise from a variety of disciplines including model-based reinforcement learning, planning and optimal control, deep learning, world models, and safe reinforcement learning, our Research Scientists are at the forefront of groundbreaking research and applying it to real-world industrial control systems.</p> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Responsibilities</span></h3> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and evaluate model-based reinforcement learning agents — including planning-based controllers (MPC, MPPI) — and the software prototypes needed to deploy them on real industrial control systems.</li> <li>Develop learned dynamics and world models (learned surrogates) that generalize across systems, including the training pipelines — pretraining, curriculum learning, active/adversarial learning, and fine-tuning — needed to make them reliable for planning and control.</li> <li>Research and implement methods for e.g. safe RL, constrained control, scenario planning and Bayesian RL, to develop agents that satisfy safety constraints during deployment.</li> <li>Report and present research findings and developments including status and results clearly and efficiently both internally and externally, verbally and in writing.</li> <li>Participate in and organize ambitious collaborative research projects, and work with external collaborators and partners to translate research into production outcomes.</li> <li>Mentor and guide Research Engineers to apply research findings and developments to industrial domains.</li> <li>Independently defines new research directions</li> <li>Translates research into practical outcomes</li> <li>Owns the development and rollout for an entire research area or large project</li> </ul> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Key Qualifications</span></h3> <ul> <li>PhD in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with a <strong>strong background in model-based reinforcement learning</strong> and demonstrated knowledge in one or more of the following: <ul> <li>Planning algorithms</li> <li>World models / learned dynamics surrogates</li> <li>Reinforcement Learning and Deep Learning</li> <li>Control Theory</li> <li>Safe / constrained RL</li> </ul> </li> <li>Either: <ul> <li>2+ years of research experience in academia or industry after PhD graduation.</li> <li>5+ years of research experience in academia or industry after Master’s graduation.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Extensive research in the fields of {ModelBased, ModelFree, Safe} RL and Control Theory, with particular depth in model-based methods.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and evaluating agents against simulators (e.g. differentiable simulators or world models) and closing the sim-to-real gap.</li> <li>Alignment with Phaidra's values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, &amp; Truth.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Preferred Skills &amp; Experience</span></h3> <ul> <li>PhD in machine learning, control, or a closely related field.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on experience with model-based RL and planning agents applied to real-world dynamical or industrial systems.</li> <li>Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including vectorized/differentiable simulators and scaling experiments on distributed compute (e.g. Ray, Kubernetes, GCP).</li> <li>A proven track record of publications in RL, control, or a related area.</li> <li>A real passion for AI and applying it to industrial systems to improve resource efficiency.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Our Stack&nbsp;</span></h3> <ul> <li>Python</li> <li>PyTorch, scipy</li> <li>Kubernetes, Docker, Ray</li> <li>GCP</li> </ul> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Onboarding</span></h3> <p><strong>In your first 30 days...</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will be immersed in an onboarding program that introduces you to Phaidra and our product.</li> <li>You will spend time in the research team and get introduced to the different tracks of research that we perform.</li> <li>You will learn how other teams operate, interact, and approach problems.</li> <li>You will read various parts of our handbook and familiarize yourself with the documentation culture at Phaidra.</li> <li>You will set up your development environment and get introduced to various parts of our code base.</li> </ul> <p><strong>By your first 60 days...</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will have a solid understanding of what Phaidra does and how we do it.</li> <li>You will have met with team members across Phaidra and started building relationships that will help you be successful at your job.</li> <li>You will have a good understanding of our research tracks, which allowed you to form a plan for your first project, or maybe, you have already started one.</li> </ul> <p><strong>By your first 90 days...</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will have been fully integrated in the team and with team members across the company.</li> <li>You will have started to contribute to knowledge sharing throughout Phaidra.</li> <li>Your project is in full swing and you might have some early results already.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;">General Interview Process</span></h3> <p>All of our interviews are held via Google Meet, and an active camera connection is required.</p> <ol> <li>Meeting with People Operations team member (30 minutes)&nbsp;</li> <li>Meeting with Hiring Manager (30 minutes)</li> <li>Technical Conversation with Research team member (60 minutes)</li> <li>Technical Conversation with Hiring Manager (60 minutes)</li> <li>Culture fit interview with Phaidra’s co-founders (30 minutes)</li> </ol> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Base Salary</strong></span></h3> <div>UK Residents:</div> <ul> <li>Tier 1 (London): 96,159 GBP - 132,219 GBP</li> <li>Tier 2 (Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Bristol): 90,502 GBP - 124,441 GBP</li> <li>Tier 3 (Smaller cities / rural areas): 84,847 GBP - 116,664 GBP</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 14px;">In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for equity.&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">Final salary will be determined based on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, expertise, education and location. In some cases, final compensation may fall outside the posted range. Salary ranges are regularly reviewed and may be adjusted in response to market trends.</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Fast-paced, team-oriented environment where your work directly shapes the company’s direction.</li> <li>We are a 100% remote company.&nbsp;</li> <li>Competitive compensation &amp; meaningful equity.</li> <li>Outsized responsibilities &amp; professional development.</li> <li>Training is foundational; functional, customer immersion, and development training.</li> <li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance (exact benefits vary by region).</li> <li>Unlimited paid time off, with a required minimum of 20 days per year.</li> <li>Paid parental leave (exact benefits vary by region).</li> <li>Flexible stipends to support your workspace, well-being, and continued professional development.</li> <li>Company MacBook.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please note:</strong> Not all of Phaidra’s benefits and perks listed above apply to temporary employees such as interns.</p> <h3><strong>On being Remote</strong></h3> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">We take a thoughtful and intentional approach to remote collaboration. Inspired by pioneers like GitLab, we embrace proven best practices to foster an exceptional remote work environment. Our culture is documentation-first, and we prioritize asynchronous communication to support focus and flexibility across time zones. While we value independence, we stay closely connected through tools like Slack and video conferencing. Weekly all-hands meetings help us align and build strong relationships, and we regularly host virtual team-building activities and social events to maintain a sense of camaraderie.</span></p> <h3><strong>Equal Opportunity Employment</strong></h3> <p>Phaidra is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Phaidra is governed on the basis of merit, competence, and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status. We welcome diversity and strive to maintain an inclusive environment for all employees. As required by law, we will provide the SSA and, if necessary, the DHS, with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization for those residing in the United States.</p> <p>Additional information about E-Verify can be found <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1E2bNjdEIG-f7tZ2Hg_zFXR2FjT4idYz-/view?usp=share_link">here</a>.</p> <p><em>#LI-Remote</em></p> <p>To be considered for any position at Phaidra, you must submit an online application. Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Overview

Relay is a parcel delivery network. Every night, parcels from online retailers arrive at our sort centres, are sorted into delivery routes, and go out the next day with couriers. Two things have to go right for that to work.

Routing is the planning side: software that decides, before parcels have even arrived, which ones to expect, how to group them into routes, and how to make those routes efficient for couriers to drive. Sortation is the physical side: warehouse teams and sorting robots turning a building full of parcels into neatly separated routes, thousands of times a night.

The two are tightly coupled. If the plan expects a parcel that never arrives, a courier's route has a hole in it. If the warehouse sorts a parcel the plan didn't expect, it has nowhere to go. This role owns the analytics across both: spotting when either side is off, working out why, and building the case for what to change.

Your work splits between a daily operational rhythm (is the network healthy this morning, and if not, why) and deeper investigations (what is driving cost, where is the plan falling short of what's possible, what should we change). Your analysis won't sit in a dashboard waiting to be discovered - it will change which parcels get planned for, how warehouse shifts are scheduled, and where the operation focuses its improvement efforts.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 data engineers, analysts, and data scientists, with analysts embedded into teams across the business. You will sit with the Routing & Sortation teams but report into the central data team, working daily with software engineers, warehouse operations, commercial, and finance.

What You'll Do

Routing

  • Monitor the health of each night's route plans: how many parcels each route carries (planned vs what actually happened), how far couriers travel before their first delivery, and the routes no courier should ever be handed - a single parcel stranded miles from every other stop, or one route torn between two towns - and diagnose the cause when any of it moves

  • Track how well we predict which parcels will arrive each night: when expected parcels don't show up, or unexpected ones do, work out whether the cause was the retailer's data, a warehouse error, or timing, and improve the prediction rules client by client

  • Act on what you find: flag issues to warehouse managers and retailer-facing teams, and correct the plan when a retailer's parcels arrive outside the normal flow

  • Monitor the route optimisation engine itself and flag regressions when the software or its inputs change

  • Quantify how route design affects courier productivity: deliveries per hour, stops per route, distance between drops - and how far our actual routes sit from the best theoretically possible

  • Build the reporting that diagnoses the middle leg of the network: the van journeys that move sorted parcels from sort centres out to local pick-up points where couriers collect them

  • Partner with the engineers who build the routing systems to test and validate changes

Sortation

  • Investigate cost per parcel: where are we spending too much, where are savings available, and what's driving the variance

  • Track warehouse operative performance: throughput, accuracy, shift utilisation, and the balance between permanent and agency labour

  • Monitor sorting robot efficiency and capacity: what volumes can they sustain, where are the bottlenecks, how do they compare to manual sorting

  • Build models to predict how many operatives each shift needs, and help automate workforce planning around the best performers

  • Compare the parcel volumes retailers actually send us against what they told us to expect, and find where the gaps come from

  • Define KPIs and build dashboards that make routing and sortation performance transparent to operations and leadership

  • Work with commercial teams to set volume limits and delivery timings that balance growth with operational stability

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

  • You want to understand how an operation actually works, not just analyse it from a distance

  • You're comfortable being the person operations and engineering ping first when something looks off in the morning, and you enjoy the detective work of finding out why

  • You're excited by cost and efficiency problems - finding where money or time is leaking and building the case for how to fix it

  • You can navigate messy operational data and turn it into metrics people trust

  • You know how to take a large amount of complex data and visualise it in a way people can actually digest - your dashboards tell someone what to look at and why, rather than presenting every number you have

  • You're comfortable working with operations teams and embedding your analysis into their daily workflows

  • You're fluent in SQL and experienced with BI tools, with strong problem-solving instincts

  • You have at least 3 years experience, ideally with some exposure to logistics or another physical operation

  • You care about impact, not just insight - you measure success by whether the operation runs better

  • You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and can explain what the data shows and where the limitations are

Fast and Focused Hiring Process

  1. Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins | Online

  2. Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins

  3. SQL Live Coding - 60mins

  4. Case Study - 60mins

  5. Relay Operating Principles & Impact- 60mins

  6. Decision and offer within 48 hours. Our process mirrors our pace of work.

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

title: Privacy & Product Counsel
description: Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies. We're looking for a Privacy & Product Counsel who can build Hilbert's privacy program from the inside of the product - not bolt one on after the fact - who is fluent across US, UK, and European privacy law, and who can move at the speed our engineering and GTM teams already move at, with the ownership and urgency of a startup culture. You'll be the first dedicated privacy hire, embedded with product and engineering as we design agentic systems that touch consumer data across dozens of enterprise environments and the person our biggest customers' legal and security teams call when they want to understand how our AI actually handles their data - wherever they're based. You'll also be the generalist backstop for whatever legal question lands on the desk that week. THE ROLE You'll work directly with the founding team and across product, engineering, and GTM to build and run Hilbert's privacy program end-to-end - while also owning the product and commercial legal work that comes with selling an agentic AI platform into enterprise accounts. The environment is high-autonomy and high-ambiguity - new data types, new customer environments, and new AI capabilities show up faster than settled law does. What you'll do: Privacy Program Design, build, and run Hilbert's privacy program - policies, data mapping, retention, and vendor/subprocessor management - from the ground up, covering both US and UK/EU entities and data flows Advise product and engineering on privacy-by-design for agentic workflows: what data an agent can access, retain, infer, or act on, and how that's documented and defensible under whichever regime applies Own compliance posture across CCPA/CPRA and the US state privacy patchwork, UK GDPR/DPA 2018, and EU GDPR, and track how state, federal, UK, and EU AI-specific rules are developing Build and maintain data processing agreements, international data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, UK IDTA/Addendum), and subprocessor frameworks that scale across enterprise customers without a bespoke redline every time Product & Commercial Counsel Review and negotiate enterprise customer contracts, DPAs, and security addenda across US and UK/EU counterparties, working closely with sales to keep deals moving without compromising the company's data commitments Advise product on how new agentic features get built, marketed, and disclosed — including where an AI decision needs a human-in-the-loop checkpoint for legal or trust reasons Partner with security on incident response, breach notification obligations, and customer-facing security representations across jurisdictions Be the primary point of contact for enterprise customers' legal, security, and procurement teams when they ask how Hilbert's AI handles their data WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE The right person in this role is quick to turn regulatory nuance into a product decision and show up with both engineers and enterprise counterparts. The profile: You have 6–7 years of PQE in privacy and product/commercial counsel , ideally split between in-house work at a data-intensive or AI company and enterprise contract negotiation. You're genuinely fluent across US, UK, and EU privacy law — CCPA/CPRA and the state patchwork, UK GDPR/DPA 2018, and EU GDPR. You think like a product person, not just a lawyer. You'd rather sit in a design review and shape a data flow before it's built than redline it after. You've negotiated enterprise DPAs, security addenda, and cross-border transfer mechanisms directly . You're a genuine generalist, not just a specialist who's willing to help out. You communicate with clarity and conviction. You can explain a data-retention tradeoff to a founder, hold your ground with an enterprise customer's outside counsel, and walk an engineer through why a feature needs a consent gate — all in the same day. You take ownership. There's no one to hand this to. If the privacy program has a gap, you close it. If a deal is stuck on a legal term, you find the path through. You move at startup speed. Deals close fast, product ships fast, and you're available and responsive without needing a legal-ops process to get there. Location San Francisco or London, hybrid, with occasional travel for customer engagements and to work with the other office. The Hiring Journey Short form → Intro call → Working session with product & engineering → Team conversations → Offer Fast, human, no bureaucracy. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. raw.title: AI Enablement Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

 

The role

AI is reshaping how legal work gets done, and at Legora we're not just watching that happen — we're building it from the inside.

Our AI Enablement function exists to make sure every team at Legora can build, use, and govern AI well. The function is young, the mandate is broad, and right now it's one person. You'd be joining to own a significant slice of that work — managing engineers, translating business needs into action, and becoming the go-to for anything AI across the organization.

This is a high-ownership generalist seat for someone energized by ambiguity who would rather figure it out and ship than wait for a perfect brief.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

We operate across three streams — you'll own initiatives in all of them, from rough idea to shipped result:

Build

  • Coordinate agent and internal tool builds with engineers, keeping projects moving and translating between business needs and technical direction.

Enable

  • Run training, workshops, and documentation that help teams adopt AI.

  • Build and grow an AI champions program across the org.

  • Be the day-to-day support that makes enablement actually land.

Govern

  • Draft and operationalize guidelines, access policies, and usage guardrails.

  • Put the standards in place that let us move fast safely.

Across all three, you'll act as a connector — building the relationships and touchpoints that make the function visible and trusted.

 

Who You Are

  • Technical foundation: engineering degree (or equivalent), enough coding exposure to hold your own with engineers.

  • A few years in a fast-moving environment — ops, strategy, product, consulting, program management, or similar. Shape matters more than title.

  • Genuinely AI-native, or clearly on the way: you reach for AI tools by default and want to go deeper.

  • True generalist: comfortable switching between strategy, delivery, and people work in the same day.

  • Exceptional learning speed — you get to depth on unfamiliar things fast and take feedback in quickly.

  • Strong communicator with a low-ego, collaborative style.

 

Nice to have

  • Exposure to legal, GTM, or a regulated / high-trust environment.

  • Experience with agent platforms, workflow tools, or no/low-code AI.

  • A track record of starting something from scratch.

 

What Success Looks Like (the first 6 months)

  • You’re independently owning initiatives end-to-end across all three streams.

  • You've taken real ground on at least one initiative in each stream.

  • You’re a go to person for questions on AI Enablement at Legora.

 

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
